name: PerfectServe
training: Our Support Specialists go through initial onboarding and training together, which will align with a Monday - Friday day (EST) schedule. Once initial onboarding and training are complete, Support Specialists will start working their scheduled shift assignment. The expectation for this role is 100% attendance during the first 60 days of employment. Specifically during the training and nesting period, to ensure maximum success in your new role.
